sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  ABS(MAX((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_delivered_carrier_date::date)))::int AS delivery_time_days
FROM
  orders o
WHERE
  o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_delivered_carrier_date::date) >= 0
GROUP BY
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10)
ORDER BY
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10);
